name: isaac-mcp
description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab simulation via MCP — load USD scenes, spawn robots, run GPU physics, AI workflows

tools.name: sim_status
tools.description: Health check: Isaac Sim availability, GPU info, depot, active jobs

tools.name: load_scene
tools.description: Load a USD/URDF scene file into the scene depot

tools.name: spawn_model
tools.description: Spawn a USD/URDF model into a loaded scene

tools.name: start_sim
tools.description: Start Isaac Sim as a background subprocess (returns job_id)

tools.name: stop_sim
tools.description: Stop a running simulation by job_id

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read joint positions, velocities, sensor data for a job

tools.name: apply_control
tools.description: Apply joint torques/positions/velocities to a running sim

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List all USD scenes in the depot

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List active and completed simulation jobs

tools.name: isaac_shutdown
tools.description: Stop active sims and terminate the server (confirmed=true)

tools.name: agentic_sim_workflow
tools.description: Autonomous multi-step simulation workflow via host LLM

tools.name: natural_language_control
tools.description: NL command to actuator values for a running sim

tools.name: analyze_sim_state
tools.description: NL analysis of robot posture/behaviour from sim state

tools.name: analyze_sim_logs
tools.description: Root-cause diagnosis from sim runner logs

tools.name: discover_model
tools.description: Find USD/URDF robot models from GitHub via LLM
